candidate_guard.statement: This literary proposal supplies candidate boundaries only and does not create, replace, or authorize an official Mark map.

routing_principle: Prefer complete scenes, exchanges, intercalations, discourse movements, miracle cycles, trial sequences, and passion episodes. Rapid kai/euthys chaining supports flow but does not independently create verse-sized units.

macro_parents.label: Calls and first Galilean scene cycle
Sea crossing, deliverance, and intercalated healings
Rejection, mission, Herod report, and return
Provision, sea crossing, and landing cycle
Purity dispute, border encounters, provision, and sign dispute
Bread misunderstanding, restored sight, recognition, prediction, and mountain scene
Entry, temple frame, controversies, and treasury scene
Private discourse: warnings, signs, analogy, and watchfulness
Passion movement: plot, meal, prayer, arrest, hearing, and denial
Roman hearing, mockery, crucifixion, death, and burial
Tomb report and received ending coordinate

intercalation_parents.label: Family concern / scribal accusation / family arrival
Jairus request / woman in crowd / Jairus household
Mission sending / Herod and John report / mission return
Fig tree / temple action / fig tree interpretation
Peter follows / council hearing / Peter denies

over_split_premortem: Do not convert rapid kai/euthys chaining into verse atoms without a genuine scene, speaker, location, form, or closure reset.
Do not sever an intercalated B scene without preserving its A-B-A parent and exact internal alternatives.
Do not separate questions from answers, accusations from replies, parables from explanations, predictions from responses, or warnings from their watchfulness close.
Do not let chapter numbers, headings, red letters, morphology, variants, or parallel passages control a boundary.
Do not fragment meal, prayer, arrest, hearing, death, burial, tomb, or ending movements into isolated sayings.

ending_guard.statement: The supplied coordinate is covered exactly, while ending questions remain explicitly non-authorizing and require external textual review plus human adjudication.

units.title: Opening heading and wilderness preparation
units.scene_marker: The opening nominal heading flows into the written-as formula and John's arrival.
units.speaker_marker: The narrator yields to quoted preparation and John's direct forecast without changing the governing introductory function.
units.location_marker: Wilderness and Jordan geography remain within one preparation movement.
units.form_marker: Heading, quotation chain, activity summary, and proclamation progress as an introduction.
units.closure_marker: John's forecast of the coming baptizer supplies the movement's close.
units.over_split_premortem: Splitting verse 1 or each quotation would turn introductory components into isolated atoms.
units.defensible_basis: Heading through forecast forms the complete preparatory threshold.

units.title: Baptism and wilderness testing
units.scene_marker: In those days introduces Jesus; immediate movement from water to wilderness keeps the rapid preparation sequence.
units.speaker_marker: Narration contains a heavenly voice, then returns to compressed narrator report.
units.location_marker: Jordan gives way to wilderness, but the Spirit-driven continuity binds the scenes.
units.form_marker: Descent, voice, driving, testing, and service create a paired initiatory form.
units.closure_marker: Forty-day summary and angelic service finish the wilderness action.
units.over_split_premortem: Atomizing at every immediately would mistake rapid linkage for separate primary units.
units.defensible_basis: The same introduced figure and Spirit-linked action support a compact paired unit.

units.title: Galilean proclamation summary
units.scene_marker: John's custody and Jesus' arrival in Galilee reset the narrative phase.
units.speaker_marker: Narrator summary culminates in a compact direct proclamation.
units.location_marker: Galilee replaces the wilderness preparation settings.
units.form_marker: Temporal transition plus summarized preaching marks a programmatic scene bridge.
units.closure_marker: The two-clause proclamation ends the summary before shoreline action begins.
units.over_split_premortem: Merging all opening material would hide the explicit after-John transition.
units.defensible_basis: A temporal reset and concentrated summary justify the small but complete unit.

units.title: Calling two pairs by the sea
units.scene_marker: Passing along the sea begins two parallel encounter-and-response scenes.
units.speaker_marker: Jesus' summons and the pairs' nonverbal responses repeat in matched form.
units.location_marker: The sea and nearby boats remain stable across both calls.
units.form_marker: Repeated seeing, calling, leaving, and following create a deliberate diptych.
units.closure_marker: The second pair's departure completes the parallel series.
units.over_split_premortem: Separating the pairs is possible, but risks obscuring their repeated syntax and joint function.
units.defensible_basis: Parallel call-response structure gives the span literary wholeness.

units.title: Synagogue teaching and exorcism
units.scene_marker: Entry into Capernaum and the synagogue establishes a new public episode.
units.speaker_marker: Narrator reaction frames a spirit's challenge and Jesus' command.
units.location_marker: The synagogue is stable from teaching through report.
units.form_marker: Teaching astonishment develops into enacted confrontation and collective interpretation.
units.closure_marker: Amazement and spreading report close the public scene.
units.over_split_premortem: Splitting teaching from exorcism would sever the crowd's combined authority reaction.
units.defensible_basis: Setting, confrontation, response, and report form a complete scene.

units.title: House healing and evening gathering
units.scene_marker: Leaving the synagogue and entering Simon and Andrew's house begins a new scene.
units.speaker_marker: A reported illness prompts action; evening narration broadens beyond the household.
units.location_marker: The house and its doorway govern individual healing and city gathering.
units.form_marker: A request-action-response encounter expands into a healing catalogue.
units.closure_marker: Sunset gathering and generalized cures close the day's house sequence.
units.over_split_premortem: Splitting at sunset is defensible but may detach the public expansion from its household base.
units.defensible_basis: Location continuity and individual-to-summary progression support one unit.

units.title: Withdrawal, search, and wider itinerary
units.scene_marker: Early darkness and solitary departure reset time and action.
units.speaker_marker: The searchers' report elicits a destination statement followed by narrator summary.
units.location_marker: Deserted place opens into neighboring towns and Galilean synagogues.
units.form_marker: Prayer, search, reply, and itinerary form a transition sequence.
units.closure_marker: The generalized tour statement completes the decision to go elsewhere.
units.over_split_premortem: Ending at the reply would detach its narrated enactment.
units.defensible_basis: The summary realizes the preceding dialogue and closes the withdrawal movement.

units.title: Cleansing request and publicity reversal
units.scene_marker: A petitioner approaches after the itinerary summary and initiates a discrete encounter.
units.speaker_marker: Request and command yield to warning, disobedient proclamation, and narrator consequence.
units.location_marker: No named location governs; the final deserted-place notice provides the geographic result.
units.form_marker: Petition, touch, cure, dismissal, and reversal produce a complete episode.
units.closure_marker: Publicity displaces Jesus outside cities while crowds continue coming.
units.over_split_premortem: Stopping at the cure would omit the command-and-reversal ending that reshapes the scene.
units.defensible_basis: The aftermath is the encounter's explicit narrative consequence.

units.title: Paralytic lowered through the roof
units.scene_marker: Return to Capernaum and a crowded house open a new episode.
units.speaker_marker: Jesus' address to the paralytic provokes silent scribal reasoning and a spoken counterquestion.
units.location_marker: The house and blocked doorway remain stable throughout.
units.form_marker: Access problem, pronouncement, controversy, demonstrative command, and cure form an arc.
units.closure_marker: The man's exit and universal amazement close the scene.
units.over_split_premortem: Splitting miracle from controversy would remove the action that resolves the dispute.
units.defensible_basis: Problem, objection, answer, cure, and crowd response are mutually dependent.

units.title: Levi called and table questioned
units.scene_marker: Going out beside the sea introduces Levi, then the action continues at table.
units.speaker_marker: A summons and response lead to scribal questioning and Jesus' proverb-like reply.
units.location_marker: Seaside movement shifts to a house meal, but Levi's following supplies continuity.
units.form_marker: Call narrative expands into association controversy.
units.closure_marker: Jesus' physician-and-call saying answers the objection and closes the exchange.
units.over_split_premortem: Atomizing the call would detach the table controversy generated by the new association.
units.defensible_basis: The meal is the narrative consequence of the summons.

units.title: Question about fasting
units.scene_marker: A new group and fasting practice introduce a separate question.
units.speaker_marker: The question receives a bridegroom reply followed by cloth and wineskin comparisons.
units.location_marker: No new named place is supplied; participant reset is more decisive than geography.
units.form_marker: Question, temporal saying, and paired metaphors comprise one answer.
units.closure_marker: The fresh-wineskins image completes the comparison series.
units.over_split_premortem: Separating the metaphors would fragment a single sustained answer.
units.defensible_basis: All three images respond to the same initiating question.

units.title: Two Sabbath controversies and conspiracy
units.scene_marker: Travel through grainfields begins one dispute; synagogue entry begins a second, climactic test.
units.speaker_marker: Pharisaic questions and Jesus' replies recur, ending in opponents' deliberation.
units.location_marker: Grainfields shift to synagogue, a genuine internal seam preserved as an exact alternative.
units.form_marker: Two question-action-response forms share Sabbath vocabulary and escalating opposition.
units.closure_marker: The departure and conspiracy give the paired cycle a strong external close.
units.over_split_premortem: Chapter-based splitting is valid internally, but treating either dispute alone loses the escalation to conspiracy.
units.defensible_basis: Repeated topic and opponent response create a cross-chapter controversy climax.

units.title: Withdrawal to the sea and crowd pressure
units.scene_marker: Withdrawal after the conspiracy resets both movement and scale.
units.speaker_marker: Narration dominates, interrupted by repeated spirit cries and silencing commands.
units.location_marker: Sea, boat provision, and a multi-region crowd define the setting.
units.form_marker: Geographic catalogue and generalized healing replace the prior controversy dialogue.
units.closure_marker: The stern prohibition ends the summary before mountain ascent.
units.over_split_premortem: Dividing the region list from the healing pressure would atomize one crowd summary.
units.defensible_basis: Withdrawal, crowd influx, pressure, cries, and command form one movement.

units.title: Appointment of the twelve
units.scene_marker: Mountain ascent and selective calling initiate a new formal action.
units.speaker_marker: Narrator purpose clauses introduce a name list with embedded naming notes.
units.location_marker: The mountain separates appointment from the preceding sea crowd.
units.form_marker: Appointment formula, purposes, and roster constitute a list-form unit.
units.closure_marker: Judas' concluding descriptor ends the roster before house activity resumes.
units.over_split_premortem: Splitting roster entries or textual hot spots would mistake list components for scenes.
units.defensible_basis: The full appointment formula and complete roster must remain together.

units.title: Family, scribes, and redefined kinship
units.scene_marker: Crowd pressure and family action open A; Jerusalem scribes introduce B; family arrival resumes A.
units.speaker_marker: Family report encloses Jesus' response to scribal accusations and his final kinship sayings.
units.location_marker: A house/crowd setting frames both outside family action and inner dispute.
units.form_marker: Concern narrative is interrupted by parabolic rebuttal, then completed by arrival and pronouncement.
units.closure_marker: The final whoever-saying answers the resumed family scene.
units.over_split_premortem: Splitting only at speaker changes would erase the enclosing family frame.
units.defensible_basis: The outer action resumes explicitly after the inner controversy.

units.title: Sower parable, audience question, and explanation
units.scene_marker: Seaside teaching to a great crowd opens the story; being alone shifts audience for explanation.
units.speaker_marker: Public narration yields to private question and extended interpretation by the same speaker.
units.location_marker: Boat-and-shore public setting changes to private company, an internal discourse seam.
units.form_marker: Story, hearing refrain, purpose dialogue, and element-by-element explanation form one teaching arc.
units.closure_marker: The final fruitful-soil explanation completes the pattern.
units.over_split_premortem: Separating explanation from story would weaken their explicit question-and-return relation.
units.defensible_basis: The explanation maps directly onto the preceding four soils.

units.title: Lamp, disclosure, hearing, and measure
units.scene_marker: A renewed he-said formula introduces a compact group after the sower explanation.
units.speaker_marker: Rhetorical questions and direct warning maintain one addressee frame.
units.location_marker: Private discourse setting continues without a narrated move.
units.form_marker: Lamp image, hearing refrain, measure saying, and has/has-not maxim form a linked wisdom cluster.
units.closure_marker: The final antithetical maxim closes the cluster before a new seed comparison.
units.over_split_premortem: Splitting each maxim would overread repeated speech formulas inside a compact teaching run.
units.defensible_basis: Hearing vocabulary links imagery, warning, and conclusion.

units.title: Growing seed, mustard seed, and parable coda
units.literary_form: paired seed parables with narrator summary
units.scene_marker: A kingdom comparison begins a new miniature narrative, followed by a second explicit comparison.
units.speaker_marker: Jesus remains speaker until the narrator summarizes public parable practice and private explanation.
units.location_marker: The same teaching frame continues; no location change overrides the form reset.
units.form_marker: Two growth parables form a pair and the narrator supplies a discourse coda.
units.closure_marker: The public/private summary closes the entire parable session.
units.over_split_premortem: Isolating the coda or every seed image would lose the paired growth form and session closure.
units.defensible_basis: Repeated sowing imagery and explicit narrator summary bind the span.

units.title: Storm stilled on the crossing
units.scene_marker: On that day at evening initiates departure across the sea.
units.speaker_marker: Disciples' plea and Jesus' commands lead to his question and their closing question.
units.location_marker: The boat and storming sea remain stable until calm.
units.form_marker: Departure, danger, waking, rebuke, calm, and fear follow a complete problem-resolution sequence.
units.closure_marker: The disciples' unresolved who-question closes the scene at the shoreward boundary.
units.over_split_premortem: Joining every rapid sea event risks obscuring the landing and new participant at 5:1.
units.defensible_basis: Boat setting and final question provide a coherent first movement of the larger cycle.

units.title: The man among the tombs
units.scene_marker: Landing introduces a new solitary figure and a sustained confrontation.
units.speaker_marker: Spirit speech, Jesus' commands, local reports, and the restored man's request all belong to the encounter.
units.location_marker: The far-shore region, tombs, hillside, city response, and departing boat frame the episode.
units.form_marker: Confrontation, transfer, communal inspection, departure request, and commissioned report form one arc.
units.closure_marker: The restored man's regional proclamation completes the aftermath.
units.over_split_premortem: Splitting at the pigs' rush would detach the communal and personal responses that finish the scene.
units.defensible_basis: Arrival-to-departure geography and participant resolution support the span.

units.title: Jairus, the woman, and Jairus's daughter
units.scene_marker: The return crossing introduces Jairus as outer A; a woman interrupts as B; messengers resume the household story as A-prime.
units.speaker_marker: Jairus's plea encloses the woman's inner dialogue and the final household commands.
units.location_marker: Seashore and journey lead into the house, while the interruption occurs inside the same pressing crowd.
units.form_marker: An interrupted request resumes explicitly after the inner cure.
units.closure_marker: Food instruction and secrecy command close the restored outer scene.
units.over_split_premortem: Separate addressable scenes are valid alternatives, but losing their parent erases the designed interruption.
units.defensible_basis: The while-he-was-still-speaking return makes the enclosure explicit.

units.title: Hometown teaching and rejection
units.scene_marker: Departure and arrival in his own country initiate a new local encounter.
units.speaker_marker: Synagogue questions receive a proverb-like reply, followed by narrator evaluation.
units.location_marker: Home country and synagogue distinguish the episode from the prior lakeside action.
units.form_marker: Teaching, astonished questioning, offense, reply, limited action, and marvel form the sequence.
units.closure_marker: The narrator's final marvel closes the hometown response.
units.over_split_premortem: Splitting every crowd question would atomize a collective response scene.
units.defensible_basis: Arrival, response, proverb, and concluding evaluation cohere.

units.title: Sending the twelve
units.scene_marker: Calling the twelve initiates paired sending after the hometown scene.
units.speaker_marker: Jesus' commands yield to a concise report of their going, preaching, and actions.
units.location_marker: No fixed location governs because travel is the commissioned action.
units.form_marker: Authorization, equipment and lodging instructions, rejection procedure, and enactment form one movement.
units.closure_marker: The mission summary closes outer A before the Herod report.
units.over_split_premortem: Ending at the instructions would detach their immediate narrated performance.
units.defensible_basis: Command and enactment together establish the mission's opening frame.

units.title: Herod hears and John's death is recounted
units.scene_marker: Herod's hearing triggers alternative reports and a for-explanation that moves backward into John's arrest.
units.speaker_marker: Public opinions, Herod's conclusion, John's rebuke, banquet dialogue, and disciple response are nested in one report.
units.location_marker: Prison and banquet settings occupy the inner B scene between mission departure and return.
units.form_marker: Recognition report expands into arrest background, banquet tragedy, execution, and burial.
units.closure_marker: John's disciples' burial action closes the retrospective account.
units.over_split_premortem: Separating the opening opinions from the explanation would strand the for-linked retrospective.
units.defensible_basis: Herod's claim is explained by the full embedded narrative.

units.title: Mission return and feeding the crowd
units.scene_marker: The apostles gather and report, then attempted withdrawal is overtaken by the crowd and a food problem.
units.speaker_marker: The disciples' report shifts to Jesus' invitation, crowd teaching, and provision dialogue.
units.location_marker: A boat journey leads to a deserted place where the crowd remains through the meal.
units.form_marker: Outer-A mission return becomes the transition into a complete compassion-and-provision scene.
units.closure_marker: Full eating, twelve baskets, and a participant count close the scene.
units.over_split_premortem: Ending at verse 32 preserves the sandwich seam, but would separate the attempted rest from its narrated interruption.
units.defensible_basis: Return and thwarted withdrawal lead causally into the provision episode.

units.title: Walking on the sea
units.scene_marker: Immediate embarkation and dismissal reset actors before the night crossing.
units.speaker_marker: Narration of distress and approach leads to reassurance, boarding, and narrator explanation.
units.location_marker: Boat, mountain, land, and sea separation organize the scene.
units.form_marker: Departure, solitary prayer, distress, approach, fear, reassurance, and calm create an arc.
units.closure_marker: Wind cessation, amazement, and the loaves explanation close it.
units.over_split_premortem: Splitting at each immediate would fracture a single crossing and recognition failure.
units.defensible_basis: The boat problem resolves only when Jesus boards and the wind ceases.

units.title: Landing at Gennesaret
units.scene_marker: Crossing completion and mooring open a generalized landing sequence.
units.speaker_marker: Narration dominates; local recognition produces repeated petitions rather than one dialogue.
units.location_marker: Gennesaret broadens into villages, cities, countryside, and marketplaces.
units.form_marker: Landing, recognition, running, bringing, touching, and generalized cure form a summary catalogue.
units.closure_marker: As-many-as-touched closure finishes the cycle.
units.over_split_premortem: Joining the next delegation would conflate local summary with a new Jerusalem-origin dispute.
units.defensible_basis: Explicit crossing completion and durative catalogue mark a distinct unit.

units.title: Unwashed hands, crowd saying, and private explanation
units.scene_marker: A Jerusalem-linked delegation gathers and objects; Jesus later calls the crowd and finally enters a house with disciples.
units.speaker_marker: Opponent question, public saying, and private question-answer remain on the same defilement topic.
units.location_marker: The dispute moves from public encounter to crowd address to house explanation.
units.form_marker: Accusation, countercharge, public maxim, and private catalogue form one extended controversy.
units.closure_marker: The internal-evils list concludes the explicit explanation.
units.over_split_premortem: Audience shifts offer real alternatives, but splitting them can sever the explanation from its initiating dispute.
units.defensible_basis: Repeated defile vocabulary governs all three phases.

units.title: The Syrophoenician woman's request
units.scene_marker: Departure to the Tyre-Sidon borders introduces a woman who finds the hidden house.
units.speaker_marker: Her request receives a metaphorical refusal and concise counterreply before Jesus' answer.
units.location_marker: Border region, house, and the woman's home frame the encounter.
units.form_marker: Approach, petition, metaphor, repartee, pronouncement, and verified result form a complete scene.
units.closure_marker: Finding the child with the demon gone supplies closure.
units.over_split_premortem: Stopping at the verbal exchange would omit the narrator's stated outcome.
units.defensible_basis: New participant, sustained dialogue, and home verification delimit the scene.

units.title: A deaf man with impaired speech
units.scene_marker: A renewed regional journey leads to a new brought person.
units.speaker_marker: Petition yields to private gestures, a direct command, publicity prohibition, and crowd acclamation.
units.location_marker: Travel through Decapolis reaches the sea; the man is taken aside from the crowd.
units.form_marker: Request-action-command-result-prohibition-acclamation supplies the full form.
units.closure_marker: Exceeding astonishment and collective saying close the episode.
units.over_split_premortem: Separating the publicity response would lose the episode's explicit reversal ending.
units.defensible_basis: The crowd's response resolves the command-and-proclamation tension.

units.title: Feeding the four thousand and departure
units.scene_marker: In those days and a new great crowd introduce a repeated but complete problem scene.
units.speaker_marker: Jesus summons disciples, voices concern, questions supplies, commands service, and dismisses the crowd.
units.location_marker: A deserted setting ends with boat departure to Dalmanutha.
units.form_marker: Need dialogue, distribution, satisfaction, leftovers, count, dismissal, and departure form an arc.
units.closure_marker: Crowd dismissal and immediate embarkation close the event.
units.over_split_premortem: Treating each food count as a boundary would atomize list details within a provision scene.
units.defensible_basis: Problem-resolution structure and explicit dismissal define the span.

units.title: Demand for a sign
units.scene_marker: Pharisees come out and begin questioning immediately after the landing.
units.speaker_marker: Their request receives a sigh, counterquestion, refusal, and no further exchange.
units.location_marker: The Dalmanutha-region arrival is followed by departure in the boat.
units.form_marker: Approach-test-response-departure is a compact controversy form.
units.closure_marker: He leaves them and crosses away, explicitly closing the encounter.
units.over_split_premortem: Merging it with boat instruction would ignore the opponents' exit and renewed disciple-only setting.
units.defensible_basis: New interlocutors and explicit departure form strong seams.

units.title: One loaf and the yeast warning
units.scene_marker: Forgotten bread and one loaf introduce a disciple-only problem after the opponents are left.
units.speaker_marker: A warning is misunderstood, followed by questions recalling both feedings.
units.location_marker: The boat on the crossing is the stable private setting.
units.form_marker: Warning, erroneous inference, rebuke, numerical recollection, and final question create a pedagogical sequence.
units.closure_marker: Do-you-not-yet-understand ends the exchange unresolved.
units.over_split_premortem: Splitting each recall question would repeat the very atomization the sequence resists.
units.defensible_basis: Bread vocabulary and the escalating question series unite the passage.

units.title: A blind man restored in two stages
units.scene_marker: Arrival at Bethsaida introduces a brought petitioner and a village exit.
units.speaker_marker: Minimal dialogue occurs at the intermediate sight report and final dismissal.
units.location_marker: Village, outside-village action, and homeward sending frame the episode.
units.form_marker: Bringing, touch, partial result, repeated touch, clear result, and dismissal form a distinct staged narrative.
units.closure_marker: Sending him home with a village prohibition closes the scene.
units.over_split_premortem: Dividing the two stages would destroy the formal point of repeated action toward completion.
units.defensible_basis: The staged cure is one request-to-dismissal encounter.

units.title: Questions on the road near Caesarea Philippi
units.scene_marker: Travel into the villages prompts questions while on the way.
units.speaker_marker: Jesus asks first for public reports and then for the disciples' response, ending with a command.
units.location_marker: The road near Caesarea Philippi is stable.
units.form_marker: Two-tier question-answer form culminates in a silence instruction.
units.closure_marker: The command to tell no one closes the exchange before he begins new teaching.
units.over_split_premortem: Merging all following instruction could blur the explicit he-began-to-teach reset at verse 31.
units.defensible_basis: Paired questions and final command form a bounded dialogue.

units.title: First passion prediction, rebuke, and following sayings
units.scene_marker: He began to teach marks a new phase; Peter's response triggers rebuke and a summoned-crowd address.
units.speaker_marker: Private prediction becomes public instruction without abandoning the response generated by it.
units.location_marker: The road setting persists; crowd summoning broadens the audience internally.
units.form_marker: Prediction, objection, counter-rebuke, call sayings, and final time saying create a rhetorical movement.
units.closure_marker: The solemn 9:1 saying closes the address before the six-day reset.
units.over_split_premortem: Ending at the chapter number would sever the final saying from its uninterrupted audience and syntax.
units.defensible_basis: Prediction and reaction motivate the ensuing public demands.

units.title: Mountain transformation and descent dialogue
units.scene_marker: After six days and selected companions initiate ascent; descent retains the group for questions.
units.speaker_marker: Peter's speech, the cloud voice, Jesus' command, and disciple questions occur inside one encounter.
units.location_marker: High mountain ascent and descent frame the complete episode.
units.form_marker: Transformation, appearances, proposal, voice, solitude, silence command, and explanatory dialogue form an arc.
units.closure_marker: The final written-about-him saying ends the descent interpretation.
units.over_split_premortem: Stopping at the vision would detach the descent command and explicit questions about what was seen.
units.defensible_basis: Ascent-descent enclosure and participant continuity support one unit.

units.title: The afflicted boy and failed disciples
units.scene_marker: Coming to the other disciples reveals a crowd dispute and an unsuccessful attempt.
units.speaker_marker: Public dialogue with father and spirit gives way to a private disciple question in the house.
units.location_marker: Crowd setting moves to house only for explanation of the same failure.
units.form_marker: Dispute, report, lament, father dialogue, command, restoration, and why-question form one pedagogical scene.
units.closure_marker: The private response closes the unresolved disciple failure.
units.over_split_premortem: Ending at the boy's rising would omit the directly prompted explanation.
units.defensible_basis: Public resolution and private post-scene question belong together.

units.title: Second passion prediction and incomprehension
units.scene_marker: Departure and concealed passage through Galilee introduce focused disciple instruction.
units.speaker_marker: Jesus predicts; disciples do not understand and fear asking.
units.location_marker: Travel through Galilee is a transition setting rather than a public venue.
units.form_marker: Prediction followed by explicit incomprehension forms a compact pattern.
units.closure_marker: Fear of asking closes the response before arrival in Capernaum.
units.over_split_premortem: Joining the house dispute is plausible, but can hide the prediction's repeated formal shape.
units.defensible_basis: Secrecy, prediction, and stated nonunderstanding create a complete small unit.

units.title: Who was greatest and the child
units.scene_marker: Arrival in Capernaum and entry into the house reset the scene.
units.speaker_marker: Jesus' road question meets silence, then teaching and a child-centered saying.
units.location_marker: The house supplies a private setting after travel.
units.form_marker: Question, disclosed dispute, seated instruction, enacted child placement, and saying form an arc.
units.closure_marker: The reception saying completes the symbolic action.
units.over_split_premortem: Splitting the child gesture from the rank question would sever illustration from prompt.
units.defensible_basis: Road dispute and house instruction are narratively linked.

units.title: The outsider using Jesus' name
units.scene_marker: John's direct report introduces a new case within the house teaching sequence.
units.speaker_marker: John speaks, then Jesus answers with prohibition, alignment maxim, and cup saying.
units.location_marker: No location change is narrated; speaker and topic reset govern.
units.form_marker: Objection, correction, two supporting sayings, and promised outcome form one exchange.
units.closure_marker: The no-loss saying closes the response before a new warning address.
units.over_split_premortem: Separating each supporting saying would atomize one answer to John's objection.
units.defensible_basis: Repeated in-my-name language binds the exchange.

units.title: Stumbling warnings and salt close
units.scene_marker: A whoever-causes warning shifts to direct bodily hypotheticals and closes with salt sayings.
units.speaker_marker: The same speaker maintains second-person address across repeated conditional clauses.
units.location_marker: The private instruction setting continues without narrated movement.
units.form_marker: Millstone warning, hand-foot-eye triad, fire refrain, and salt conclusion form a cumulative catalogue.
units.closure_marker: Peace-with-one-another supplies the discourse close.
units.over_split_premortem: Variant-dependent repeated verses must not become boundaries or be removed by this role.
units.defensible_basis: Repetition and final salt-peace saying delimit the whole warning movement.

units.title: Divorce question and house follow-up
units.scene_marker: Travel to Judean borders introduces opponents; house entry shifts to disciple follow-up on the same matter.
units.speaker_marker: Pharisee test, Jesus' counterquestion, public response, and private answer form one topic-bound exchange.
units.location_marker: Border crowd setting moves into the house as an internal audience seam.
units.form_marker: Test question, cited counterargument, pronouncement, and private clarification create a complete controversy.
units.closure_marker: The paired man-and-woman sayings end the follow-up.
units.over_split_premortem: Splitting public and private phases can detach the explicitly repeated same-matter question.
units.defensible_basis: Topic continuity outweighs the internal location shift.

units.title: Children brought and blessed
units.scene_marker: Newly brought children and disciple rebuke initiate a short scene.
units.speaker_marker: Narration yields to Jesus' corrective saying and embodied blessing.
units.location_marker: No named move is stated; new participants mark the reset.
units.form_marker: Bringing, rebuke, indignation, instruction, embrace, and blessing form a complete encounter.
units.closure_marker: Laying hands and blessing close the action.
units.over_split_premortem: Joining the next road encounter would merge distinct brought and running participants.
units.defensible_basis: New entrants and completed blessing provide clean boundaries.

units.title: Rich questioner and disciple discussion
units.scene_marker: Going out on the way introduces a kneeling questioner; his departure prompts extended disciple dialogue.
units.speaker_marker: Individual questions and answers shift to Jesus, disciples, and Peter without changing the governing encounter's issue.
units.location_marker: The way scene broadens into a disciple-facing continuation after the man's exit.
units.form_marker: Question, command catalogue, demand, sorrowful departure, difficulty sayings, and follower response form an arc.
units.closure_marker: The first-last reversal closes the expanded instruction.
units.over_split_premortem: Ending at the man's departure would detach the interpretive discussion caused by that departure.
units.defensible_basis: Look-around, disciple astonishment, and Peter's reply continue the same narrative problem.

units.title: Third passion prediction on the Jerusalem road
units.scene_marker: Going up to Jerusalem and taking the twelve again initiate a formal forecast.
units.speaker_marker: Narrator fear precedes Jesus' detailed prediction to the selected group.
units.location_marker: The upward Jerusalem road is explicit.
units.form_marker: Aside-taking plus a sequenced forecast repeats a recognizable form.
units.closure_marker: The third-day clause ends the forecast before a new petition.
units.over_split_premortem: Merging it with the next request can obscure the formal repeated prediction boundary.
units.defensible_basis: Travel marker, restricted audience, and detailed sequence support independence.

units.title: James and John ask; the twelve learn service
units.literary_form: petition, group reaction, and corrective teaching
units.scene_marker: Two brothers approach after the prediction; the other ten's indignation expands the scene.
units.speaker_marker: Request dialogue leads to group-directed teaching by Jesus.
units.location_marker: The journey context persists without a new named location.
units.form_marker: Petition, cup dialogue, indignation, summons, contrast, and climactic service saying form one movement.
units.closure_marker: The final service-and-ransom saying concludes the correction.
units.over_split_premortem: Ending after the brothers' answer would detach the group correction generated by their request.
units.defensible_basis: Request and collective response are causally one scene.

units.title: Bartimaeus follows on the way
units.scene_marker: Arrival at and departure from Jericho introduce a named beggar beside the road.
units.speaker_marker: Repeated cries overcome crowd rebuke; Jesus questions and pronounces before narrated following.
units.location_marker: Jericho's exit road remains stable and becomes the final following motif.
units.form_marker: Cry, resistance, intensified cry, call, approach, question, restoration, and following form an arc.
units.closure_marker: Immediate sight and following on the way close the journey scene.
units.over_split_premortem: Splitting the crowd exchange from the healing would break the escalating petition sequence.
units.defensible_basis: Road setting and final following provide literary closure.

units.title: Entry into Jerusalem and temple survey
units.scene_marker: Approach to Jerusalem prompts a two-disciple errand and culminates in city entry.
units.speaker_marker: Instruction and compliance lead to crowd acclamation; narration ends with Jesus' survey and departure.
units.location_marker: Village, road procession, Jerusalem temple, and Bethany movement define the arc.
units.form_marker: Preparation, acquisition, procession, acclamation, arrival, inspection, and exit form one event.
units.closure_marker: Evening departure to Bethany closes the entry day.
units.over_split_premortem: Ending at the acclamation would omit the temple arrival that the procession reaches.
units.defensible_basis: The survey and departure complete the narrated destination.

units.title: Fig tree, temple action, and fig tree teaching
units.scene_marker: Next-day hunger opens fig-tree A; arrival in Jerusalem inserts temple B; morning passing resumes fig-tree A-prime.
units.speaker_marker: Speech to the tree encloses temple teaching and the disciples' prompted response.
units.location_marker: Bethany road frames the Jerusalem temple insertion and return pass-by.
units.form_marker: Symbolic act is interrupted by confrontation, then interpreted after its observed result.
units.closure_marker: Prayer and forgiveness sayings, including the supplied verse 26 coordinate, close the response to Peter's notice.
units.over_split_premortem: Splitting the temple scene is addressable, but omitting the parent loses the explicit fig-tree enclosure.
units.defensible_basis: Evening exit and morning resumption mark the sandwich architecture.

units.title: Authority challenge and vineyard parable
units.scene_marker: Return to Jerusalem brings leaders' authority question; after their impasse Jesus begins speaking to them in parables.
units.speaker_marker: Jesus' counterquestion receives deliberation and nonanswer, followed by an extended story and application.
units.location_marker: The temple remains the governing public setting across the chapter seam.
units.form_marker: Challenge, counterchallenge, impasse, parable, question, quotation, recognition, and departure form a complete controversy.
units.closure_marker: Opponents leave after recognizing the story's direction, closing the exchange.
units.over_split_premortem: Chapter splitting is plausible, but can sever he-began-to-speak-to-them from its established interlocutors.
units.defensible_basis: Stable audience and their final reaction bind the cross-chapter unit.

units.title: Tax trap and coin response
units.scene_marker: A new sent coalition arrives to catch him in speech.
units.speaker_marker: Flattering question, Jesus' exposure, object request, counterquestion, and answer form the dialogue.
units.location_marker: Temple controversy setting continues, but new delegates mark the seam.
units.form_marker: Trap, demonstration, aphoristic reply, and amazement create a compact exchange.
units.closure_marker: Their marvel at him closes the scene.
units.over_split_premortem: Separating the coin demonstration would detach evidence from the reply it elicits.
units.defensible_basis: New interlocutors and final amazement delimit the episode.

units.title: Sadducees' seven-brother case
units.scene_marker: Sadducees arrive with a new premise and elaborate scenario.
units.speaker_marker: Their extended question receives a two-part corrective answer.
units.location_marker: The public temple setting continues; participant reset controls the boundary.
units.form_marker: Case recital, question, correction, and quotation-based argument form one exchange.
units.closure_marker: The final badly-mistaken verdict closes the response.
units.over_split_premortem: Splitting the hypothetical from its answer would destroy the question-response form.
units.defensible_basis: New group, single case, and terminal verdict establish wholeness.

units.title: A scribe asks the greatest commandment
units.scene_marker: A scribe approaches after hearing the disputes and asks one question.
units.speaker_marker: Jesus answers; the scribe affirms and expands; Jesus evaluates him.
units.location_marker: No location change occurs; the unusually cooperative speaker exchange creates the seam.
units.form_marker: Question, paired answer, approving response, and final evaluation form a rounded dialogue.
units.closure_marker: No one dared ask further questions supplies a cycle closure.
units.over_split_premortem: Stopping after Jesus' answer would omit the interlocutor's response and explicit question-cycle close.
units.defensible_basis: Reciprocal evaluation distinguishes this exchange from adjacent traps.

units.title: David's son question and warning about scribes
units.scene_marker: Jesus responds while teaching, then shifts to a beware warning within the same public instruction.
units.speaker_marker: Jesus asks a rhetorical textual question and continues with a descriptive warning.
units.location_marker: Temple teaching remains stable; no new participant scene intervenes.
units.form_marker: A scribal claim is questioned, then scribal public behavior is catalogued.
units.closure_marker: The greater-condemnation saying closes the warning.
units.over_split_premortem: The internal topic shift supports an alternative split, but two scribe-focused teachings form a compact diptych.
units.defensible_basis: Repeated scribe topic and continuous teaching frame support the larger row.

units.title: The widow at the treasury
units.scene_marker: Jesus sits opposite the treasury and watches a new action scene.
units.speaker_marker: Narration of gifts leads to Jesus calling disciples and interpreting one widow's act.
units.location_marker: The treasury is a new precise location.
units.form_marker: Observation, contrastive examples, summons, and comparative pronouncement form a complete vignette.
units.closure_marker: Her all-she-had statement ends the scene and temple sequence.
units.over_split_premortem: Joining chapter 13 would conflate treasury observation with temple departure and a private discourse prompt.
units.defensible_basis: New location and completed interpretation make a discrete closing vignette.

units.title: Temple departure and private questions
units.scene_marker: Leaving the temple elicits a building remark and prediction; mountain seating prompts private questions.
units.speaker_marker: One disciple speaks, Jesus replies, then four named disciples ask privately.
units.location_marker: Temple exit shifts to the Mount of Olives opposite the temple.
units.form_marker: Observation, prediction, relocation, restricted audience, and paired questions frame the discourse.
units.closure_marker: The disciples' sign question hands the floor to the sustained answer.
units.over_split_premortem: Starting at verse 5 alone would detach the setting and exact questions that organize the speech.
units.defensible_basis: Movement and prompt are essential parts of the discourse frame.

units.title: Opening warnings: deception, upheaval, and hearings
units.scene_marker: Jesus begins answering the private questions with beware language and a staged catalogue.
units.speaker_marker: One sustained speaker addresses the four disciples directly with repeated second-person warnings.
units.location_marker: The Mount of Olives setting remains stable for the full discourse.
units.form_marker: Deceivers, wars, upheavals, hearings, speech counsel, family betrayal, and endurance form the opening movement.
units.closure_marker: Endurance to the end closes this initial warning catalogue.
units.over_split_premortem: Separating every forecast item would turn a cumulative warning sequence into atoms.
units.defensible_basis: Repeated second-person warning and delivery language binds the span.

units.title: The desolating sign, flight, and false claimants
units.scene_marker: A when-you-see clause introduces a more specific trigger and urgent response sequence.
units.speaker_marker: Jesus continues direct address through imperatives and a final emphatic forewarning.
units.location_marker: Judea, housetop, field, and flight imagery form the movement's spatial field.
units.form_marker: Trigger, flight commands, distress, shortening, claimant warnings, and watch command form one unit.
units.closure_marker: I-have-told-you-all-things-beforehand closes the warned sequence.
units.over_split_premortem: Variant wording at verse 14 cannot authorize a boundary or preferred text.
units.defensible_basis: The trigger clause and concluding forewarning enclose the crisis movement.

units.title: After the oppression: signs and gathering
units.scene_marker: But in those days after that oppression provides an explicit temporal-form reset.
units.speaker_marker: The same speaker gives a compressed sequence without interlocutor interruption.
units.location_marker: Sky, clouds, four winds, earth, and heaven widen the discourse geography.
units.form_marker: Cosmic signs, coming scene, angel sending, and gathering form a concentrated tableau.
units.closure_marker: Gathering from extremities completes the movement.
units.over_split_premortem: Splitting each image would atomize one escalating forecast tableau.
units.defensible_basis: Temporal reset and gathered-ending make a coherent climax.

units.title: Fig-tree analogy and enduring words
units.scene_marker: Now from the fig tree introduces a new interpretive comparison after the tableau.
units.speaker_marker: Jesus maintains direct address and applies the analogy to what the audience sees.
units.location_marker: Seasonal tree imagery interprets nearness without a narrated location change.
units.form_marker: Analogy, application, generation saying, and words-not-pass saying form one assurance cluster.
units.closure_marker: The enduring-words contrast supplies a strong aphoristic close.
units.over_split_premortem: Isolating the generation saying would detach it from the analogy and assurance frame.
units.defensible_basis: The fig-tree lesson advances directly into paired certainty sayings.

units.title: Unknown hour and repeated watchfulness
units.scene_marker: But concerning that day marks a topic shift from signs to unknown timing.
units.speaker_marker: The same speaker broadens from the four disciples to all in the final line.
units.location_marker: Householder absence and servants supply an illustrative setting within the mountain discourse.
units.form_marker: Unknown-time statement, watch commands, short house analogy, return possibilities, and universal imperative form the close.
units.closure_marker: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch gives explicit rhetorical closure.
units.over_split_premortem: Splitting every watch imperative would destroy their deliberate refrain and final widening.
units.defensible_basis: Repeated watch language and universal closing address define the unit.

units.title: Plot, anointing, and betrayal arrangement
units.scene_marker: Two-day plot opens outer A; Bethany anointing interrupts as B; Judas's approach resumes outer A-prime.
units.speaker_marker: Conspirators' deliberation encloses Jesus' response to objections around the woman's act.
units.location_marker: Plot location shifts to a Bethany house and back to the chief priests' transaction.
units.form_marker: Killing plan, symbolic meal action, defense, memorial saying, and betrayal arrangement create the sandwich.
units.closure_marker: Judas's search for an opportunity completes the resumed plot.
units.over_split_premortem: Treating the anointing as an isolated anecdote would lose its enclosing plot frame.
units.defensible_basis: The betrayal arrangement directly resumes the action begun in verses 1-2.

units.title: Preparing the Passover
units.scene_marker: The first day and disciples' where-question introduce a new preparation scene.
units.speaker_marker: Question receives detailed instructions; disciples enact them and prepare.
units.location_marker: Movement from current location into city and upper room governs the errand.
units.form_marker: Question, sent pair, recognition signs, room instruction, discovery, and preparation form a complete task sequence.
units.closure_marker: Finding as spoken and completing preparation close the scene.
units.over_split_premortem: Joining the evening meal is possible, but may hide the full command-compliance errand form.
units.defensible_basis: Preparation is completed before the new evening arrival marker.

units.title: Evening meal, betrayal disclosure, bread and cup
units.scene_marker: When evening came begins the gathered meal after preparation.
units.speaker_marker: Jesus' betrayal disclosure prompts individual questions, then he speaks over bread and cup.
units.location_marker: The upper-room table setting remains stable until hymn and departure.
units.form_marker: Disclosure dialogue, shared food actions, interpretive sayings, final drink saying, hymn, and exit form one meal arc.
units.closure_marker: Singing and departure to the mountain close the room scene.
units.over_split_premortem: Splitting each saying would fragment a single narrated meal and departure frame.
units.defensible_basis: Continuous eating context and final exit bind the internal movements.

units.title: Scattering forecast and Peter's protest
units.scene_marker: After departure, Jesus announces group stumbling and renewed gathering.
units.speaker_marker: Jesus' forecast meets Peter's exception claim, a specific counterforecast, and repeated denial.
units.location_marker: The Mount of Olives journey setting follows the meal and precedes Gethsemane.
units.form_marker: Forecast, objection, sharpened prediction, and emphatic group protest form a compact exchange.
units.closure_marker: All saying the same thing closes the protest sequence.
units.over_split_premortem: Joining Gethsemane would merge travel dialogue with a newly named prayer place.
units.defensible_basis: Prediction and protest complete before arrival at the next setting.

units.title: Gethsemane prayer and sleeping disciples
units.scene_marker: Arrival at the named place and selection of three companions open the scene.
units.speaker_marker: Jesus' instructions and prayer alternate with repeated returns and speech to sleeping disciples.
units.location_marker: Gethsemane, a nearby withdrawal point, and return to the companions structure repetition.
units.form_marker: Three prayer/return cycles escalate toward the announced betrayer.
units.closure_marker: Rise, let us be going and the betrayer-is-near statement close the vigil.
units.over_split_premortem: Splitting each repeated cycle would obscure the designed threefold pattern.
units.defensible_basis: Stable place, repeated actions, and final movement command unify the scene.

units.title: Betrayal, arrest, and flight
units.scene_marker: While he is still speaking, Judas and an armed crowd arrive.
units.speaker_marker: Judas's signal, crowd seizure, sword action, Jesus' reply, and narrator flight report unfold continuously.
units.location_marker: Gethsemane remains the arrest setting through the young man's flight.
units.form_marker: Arrival, identification, seizure, resistance, response, abandonment, and final flight form an arc.
units.closure_marker: The young man's naked escape provides the scene's final departure.
units.over_split_premortem: Ending at the seizure would omit resistance, explanation, and universal abandonment.
units.defensible_basis: Continuous confrontation and cascading flight make one episode.

units.title: Council hearing enclosed by Peter's following and denial
units.scene_marker: Leading Jesus to the high priest opens the hearing while Peter's following supplies outer A; denial resumes as A-prime.
units.speaker_marker: Council testimony and Jesus' exchange occupy inner B between Peter's courtyard placement and three denials.
units.location_marker: High-priest interior and lower courtyard are narratively interlocked.
units.form_marker: Peter follows and warms, the hearing proceeds, then Peter's courtyard exposure fulfills the frame.
units.closure_marker: Second rooster cry, remembered saying, and weeping close the whole sequence.
units.over_split_premortem: Separating hearing and denial is addressable, but losing their enclosure removes the deliberate simultaneity.
units.defensible_basis: Peter's placement before the hearing resumes directly after its judgment.

units.title: Pilate hearing and Barabbas choice
units.scene_marker: Immediately in the morning marks consultation, binding, delivery, and a new governor setting.
units.speaker_marker: Pilate questions Jesus and the crowd through repeated exchanges while priests influence the choice.
units.location_marker: The governor's hearing space remains stable through release and handover.
units.form_marker: Accusation, silence, feast custom, crowd request, repeated question, release, scourging, and delivery form the trial arc.
units.closure_marker: Release of Barabbas and handover of Jesus close the decision.
units.over_split_premortem: Splitting preliminary questioning from the crowd choice would fragment one governor-led adjudication.
units.defensible_basis: Pilate remains the controlling actor from delivery to sentence.

units.title: Soldiers' mock coronation
units.scene_marker: Soldiers lead Jesus inside the Praetorium and call the cohort.
units.speaker_marker: Narration contains repeated mock salute and enacted homage by one group.
units.location_marker: The interior court sharply separates this scene from the public hearing and execution road.
units.form_marker: Clothing, crowning, saluting, striking, spitting, kneeling, stripping, and leading out form a ritualized sequence.
units.closure_marker: Removal of the cloak and leading out close the enclosure.
units.over_split_premortem: Joining the road would blur an enclosed mock ritual with outward movement to crucifixion.
units.defensible_basis: Location and costume reversal form clear scene boundaries.

units.title: Procession, crucifixion, inscription, and taunts
units.scene_marker: Compelling Simon begins the outward procession to Golgotha.
units.speaker_marker: Narration of execution leads into speech by passersby, leaders, and fellow crucified men.
units.location_marker: Road movement reaches the named execution site and remains there.
units.form_marker: Cross-bearing, arrival, offered drink, crucifixion, clothing division, time, inscription, companions, and taunts form one movement.
units.closure_marker: The final insults from those crucified with him close the ridicule sequence.
units.over_split_premortem: Variant presence at verse 28 cannot alone create, erase, or authorize a boundary.
units.defensible_basis: Stable execution setting and cumulative taunts support the span.

units.title: Darkness, death, immediate signs, and watching women
units.scene_marker: The sixth-hour darkness supplies an explicit temporal turn within the execution setting.
units.speaker_marker: Jesus' cry, bystander comments, and centurion statement are framed by narrator actions; women are then identified.
units.location_marker: Golgotha remains stable, widening from cross to temple veil and distant observers.
units.form_marker: Darkness, cry, misunderstanding, drink, death, torn veil, centurion response, and observer notice form the climax.
units.closure_marker: The named women and their prior following close the observer frame before evening burial.
units.over_split_premortem: Stopping at the centurion would detach the explicitly present observers who bridge into burial.
units.defensible_basis: Temporal climax and concluding observer catalogue form a larger closure.

units.title: Joseph requests and buries the body
units.scene_marker: Evening and Preparation Day introduce a new actor and task.
units.speaker_marker: Joseph's request prompts Pilate's question to the centurion and final grant.
units.location_marker: Pilate's venue leads to a rock-cut tomb, where two women observe.
units.form_marker: Request, verification, grant, purchase, wrapping, placement, stone, and observed location form a complete burial sequence.
units.closure_marker: The two women seeing where he was laid close the scene.
units.over_split_premortem: Splitting request from burial would separate authorization from its immediate enactment.
units.defensible_basis: Evening task and tomb observation supply clear beginning and end.

units.title: Women enter the tomb and flee
units.scene_marker: After the Sabbath introduces named women, spices, and a dawn journey.
units.speaker_marker: Their stone question gives way to a young man's announcement and command; narration records flight and silence.
units.location_marker: Road to tomb, tomb entrance, and flight outward structure the scene.
units.form_marker: Approach, obstacle question, discovery, messenger speech, commission, flight, trembling, and silence form an arc.
units.closure_marker: They said nothing because they were afraid is the supplied coordinate's scene close.
units.over_split_premortem: Ending questions cannot authorize a canon or preferred-reading judgment, nor can they erase this exact covered scene.
units.defensible_basis: The dawn-to-flight sequence is literarily complete while remaining textually non-authorizing.

units.title: Received ending coordinate: appearances, commission, and summary
units.scene_marker: A new first-day opening introduces successive appearance reports after 16:8.
units.speaker_marker: Narrator reports Mary and two travelers, then the eleven receive rebuke and commission.
units.location_marker: Mourning company, country road, table, heaven, and worldwide activity form a compressed sequence.
units.form_marker: Three appearance-report movements culminate in commission, departure, and confirming summary.
units.closure_marker: The disciples' worldwide preaching and accompanying confirmation close the supplied book coordinate.
units.over_split_premortem: Internal alternatives are preserved, but no boundary here selects a witness, reading, ending, or canonical ruling.
units.defensible_basis: The received coordinate is covered as one LOW deferred parent pending external textual and human review.
